issues.description: Type mismatch for the Person.birthday field: the template and the tests use java.time.LocalDate for the birthday field (and setters/getters expect LocalDate), but the solution's Person class declares the birthday attribute as String. This inconsistency will cause compilation/runtime errors and confuses students about the correct type to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.birthday field type consistent across all artifacts. Change the declaration in the solution's Person class to use java.time.LocalDate (e.g. private LocalDate birthday;) and ensure the getter/setter types match. This will align the model with the template and the tests.
